Finding.title: Client-controlled cookie is deserialized with pickle
Finding.rootCause: The /cookie route stores browser-controlled state as pickle data and passes the returned value cookie to pickle.loads.
Finding.proposedFix: Use JSON cookie serialization/deserialization for string values, reject malformed values, and HTML-escape displayed cookie content.
Finding.atomicity: Finding-scoped proposal targeting the original repository baseline. Shared helper/import concepts must be merged carefully if multiple patches are applied together.

Finding.title: DNS lookup route concatenates form input into an OS command
Finding.rootCause: The /lookup route concatenates address into a shell command executed by os.popen.
Finding.proposedFix: Remove shell execution and use validated hostname/IP input with socket.getaddrinfo.
Finding.atomicity: Finding-scoped proposal targeting the original repository baseline. Shared helper/import concepts must be merged carefully if multiple patches are applied together.
sideEffects: Lookup output changes from raw nslookup text to resolved address lines.

Finding.title: Expression evaluation route executes user input with eval
Finding.rootCause: The /evaluate route passes request.form['expression'] directly to Python eval.
Finding.proposedFix: Use an AST arithmetic evaluator that permits numeric constants and arithmetic operators only.
Finding.atomicity: Finding-scoped proposal targeting the original repository baseline. Shared helper/import concepts must be merged carefully if multiple patches are applied together.
sideEffects: Arbitrary Python expressions are no longer supported.

Finding.title: XML parser enables DTD loading and network access
Finding.rootCause: The XML route parses untrusted XML with load_dtd=True, no_network=False, and huge_tree=True.
Finding.proposedFix: Reject DOCTYPE and parse with entity resolution, DTD loading, network access, and huge_tree disabled.
Finding.atomicity: Finding-scoped proposal targeting the original repository baseline. Shared helper/import concepts must be merged carefully if multiple patches are applied together.
sideEffects: XML documents requiring DTDs are rejected.

Finding.title: Config endpoint decrypts attacker-controlled ciphertext and returns padding errors
Finding.rootCause: The config route decrypts arbitrary key query values with AES-CBC and returns raw exception text.
Finding.proposedFix: Replace decryptable config links with HMAC-signed config-key tokens and generic invalid-key errors.
Finding.atomicity: Finding-scoped proposal targeting the original repository baseline. Shared helper/import concepts must be merged carefully if multiple patches are applied together.
sideEffects: Previously generated encrypted config links become invalid.

Finding.title: Greeting route renders user input as Jinja template source
Finding.rootCause: The route inserts name into template source and calls render_template_string.
Finding.proposedFix: Escape name and return fixed HTML directly without rendering user-controlled template source.
Finding.atomicity: Finding-scoped proposal targeting the original repository baseline. Shared helper/import concepts must be merged carefully if multiple patches are applied together.
sideEffects: Jinja syntax submitted as a name is displayed as text.

Finding.title: Category query parameter is concatenated into SQL
Finding.rootCause: The category query parameter is formatted into a SQL WHERE clause.
Finding.proposedFix: Use a DB-API parameter placeholder and pass category as a bound parameter.
Finding.atomicity: Finding-scoped proposal targeting the original repository baseline. Shared helper/import concepts must be merged carefully if multiple patches are applied together.
sideEffects: External database backends need integration validation for placeholder style.

Finding.title: JWT verifier accepts None and HS256 algorithms based on untrusted token header
Finding.rootCause: verify_token dispatches verification from the untrusted JWT alg header and allows None and HS256.
Finding.proposedFix: Pin JWT verification to RS256 with expected audience and issuer.
Finding.atomicity: Finding-scoped proposal targeting the original repository baseline. Shared helper/import concepts must be merged carefully if multiple patches are applied together.
sideEffects: None and HS256 tokens are rejected.
